### Improvements

- Restore focus to the previously selected browse title after returning from details, with a safe title-card fallback.
- Keep My Library's saved card position stable while navigating to the end of poster and landscape shelves.
- Show title-logo artwork in playback loading overlays, with an animated progress fallback while artwork loads.

### Validation

- Added browse-return focus, My Library end-of-shelf navigation, and playback loading-overlay regression coverage.
- Release automation runs JVM/coverage checks, instrumentation-test compilation, lint, and a signed 32-bit APK build. Device/emulator tests are excluded from tag releases.
